# langsmith_service_key (Resource)

Manages an organization-scoped LangSmith service key.

The secret (`key`) is returned by LangSmith only once, at creation, and is therefore stored in Terraform state. Use encrypted remote state and consider writing `key` straight into a secret manager. Managing org service keys requires the provider to be authenticated with an organization-admin-capable credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create an organization-scoped LangSmith service key for CI/automation use.
resource "langsmith_service_key" "ci" {
  description = "CI / Terraform automation"

  # Optionally scope the key to specific workspaces and assign a role.
  # workspaces = [langsmith_workspace.ci.id]
  # role_id    = data.langsmith_workspace_role.admin.id
}

# The secret (`key`) is returned by LangSmith only once, at creation, and is
# stored in (sensitive) Terraform state. Write it straight into a secret manager
# rather than exposing it as a root-level output.
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "langsmith" {
  name = "langsmith/ci-service-key"
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_version" "langsmith" {
  secret_id     = aws_secretsmanager_secret.langsmith.id
  secret_string = langsmith_service_key.ci.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_workspace_id` (String) Optional default workspace ID for the key. Changing it replaces the key.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description. Changing it replaces the key.
- `expires_at` (String) Optional expiry as an RFC3339 timestamp. Changing it replaces the key.
- `org_role_id` (String) Optional organization role ID assigned to the key. Updatable in place.
- `role_id` (String) Optional workspace role ID assigned to the key. Updatable in place.
- `workspaces` (Set of String) Optional set of workspace IDs to scope the key to. Omit for an organization-wide key. Changing it replaces the key.

### Read-Only

- `access_scope` (String) Access scope of the key (organization or workspace).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_workspace_name` (String) Name of the default workspace for the key.
- `id` (String) Service key ID.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The secret service key. Returned only at creation and stored in state. Not recoverable on import.
- `last_used_at` (String) Timestamp the key was last used, if ever.
- `short_key` (String) Masked key prefix.
- `workspace_names` (List of String) Names of the workspaces the key is scoped to.
